title: Vulnerabilities in Request Tracker and RT for Incident Response software
content_md: During its own research, CERT Polska has found 3 XSS vulnerabilities (from CVE-2026-105454 to CVE-2026-105456) in Request Tracker (RT) and RT for Incident Response software (RTIR). Article Link: Vulnerabilities in Request Tracker and RT for Incident Response software | CERT Polska
